Tasks (from a requirement, a bundle, or typed), parts with unit prices, labor time and cost, readings at the start (and end), the vehicle's open squawks signed off or deferred, new squawks, a repair's complaint and cause; saved as a draft, then Finish.
A · One form in sections, like the fuel-up form: everything has its place; totals and Finish stay at the bottom
